description: This file contains unit tests for the VertexGeminiConfig class in Google's Vertex AI Gemini module, specifically testing the logic for extracting thinking blocks from parts with various 'thought' and 'thoughtSignature' attributes.

classes.name: VertexGeminiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Vertex Gemini, which includes methods for processing parts and extracting thinking blocks.

methods.name: test_thought_true_creates_thinking_block()
methods.description: Verifies that parts with thought=True and non-empty text generate a thinking block with correct content and signature.

methods.name: test_thought_true_with_empty_text_creates_block()
methods.description: Checks that parts with thought=True but empty text still generate a thinking block with empty 'thinking' content.

methods.name: test_thought_signature_without_thought_does_not_create_block()
methods.description: Ensures that parts with only 'thoughtSignature' but without 'thought=True' do not produce thinking blocks, aligning with Google's documentation.
